animation.init_two_sum: [Two Sum] L starts at the far left and R at the far right, looking for a pair that sums to {{target}}
animation.init_dedup: [Remove Duplicates] slow marks the end of the kept region; fast starts scanning from Index 1
animation.move_left: {{sum}} < {{target}}, too small: move L right to a larger number (the element L leaves can never reach the target)
animation.move_right: {{sum}} > {{target}}, too large: move R left to a smaller number (the element R leaves is always too large)
animation.scan: fast reaches Index {{fast}} with value {{fastVal}}; compare with the kept value {{slowVal}} at slow
animation.skip_duplicate: {{val}} duplicates the kept value: fast skips it, slow stays
animation.write_unique: New value {{val}}: slow advances to Index {{slow}} and writes it, growing the kept region
animation.done_dedup: Scan complete! The first {{len}} slots hold the de-duplicated result
animation.done_not_found: L and R met: no pair in the array sums to {{target}}
